name: finolabs-vibecode
description: Engineering practice for AI coding agents: routing, delegation, review and security gates, verification, versioning, agent scans and mode settings.

interface.longDescription: A skill set that gives coding agents one engineering practice. Route each change at the right depth, through Spec Kit, another workflow skill pack or a built-in procedure. Coordinate Codex, Antigravity and Claude Code agents with self-contained briefs, time budgets and verify-before-accept. Version and tag releases by SemVer, and write atomic commits. Gate each user story on an independent code and security review, and verify with targeted tests whose output is read before anything is accepted. Get one second opinion or a committee through fnl-advisor, run spec task sessions through fnl-delegate, and preserve handovers and shared decisions through fnl-session-hygiene. Before a repository goes public, review its open source readiness. Refresh present agent families with fnl-scan-agents and show or change Delegation mode and Routing with fnl-set-mode; both ask before writing local host config.
defaultPrompt: Route this change through the coding router and tell me the depth you chose.
Use fnl-delegate to coordinate this spec with one session per task.
Prepare the version bump and changelog for the next release.
Use fnl-scan-agents to refresh my local agent inventory, then fnl-set-mode to show effective settings.
